findingClassification.meaning: No actionable defect established by this bounded review. Existing accepted limitations are recorded separately; no claim of complete provider/browser correctness.

reviewedInvariants.assessment: updateSites increments its revision before awaiting preferences/filter, rejects obsolete results and requires a view. load increments the same revision when allSites changes, preventing an older pre-response filter from replacing loaded sites. A stale initial filter installs the new Organato response while preserving shown sites, then recomputes current shortcuts. Width changes across its await also trigger a refresh. Same-bucket skips preserve retry after failures through resizeLimit=null. The current stale-filter regression passes. No introduced race found; this guard does not cancel underlying filter work.

reviewedInvariants.topic: Stable-block rendering, final output and scroll
reviewedInvariants.assessment: A fully received blank line outside fences flushes all parser context. Committed nodes leave mutableNodes and stay attached; only the uncommitted tail is rebuilt. The full renderer remains the exact authored baseline prefix. Queued frames resolve current run ownership, so completion/new-chat and a later run cannot append to an old body. finish disposes the stream and renders complete text even when the last RAF has not run. Fixture checks preserve reader-away/bottom-follow decisions, final DOM equivalence and committed identity. Real browser layout/scroll anchoring was not rerun.

persistedLocal is an immutable serialized snapshot, not an alias of the subsequently mutated local.model. It updates only after storage.local.set fulfills. Local edits are captured before exchange, merged remote edits before materialization/application, and final baseline together with a changed STORE_KEY. CAS misses repeat up to four times and preserve capture. Locks serialize cooperating writers. Current fault tests pass for quota, rejected apply, transport failure, retry and appearance refusal. The serialized value lasts for one reconcile invocation and its awaits, not across all cycles. Do not remove durability captures to avoid serialization.

A fresh remaining Set per local space accepts the first matching folder in that space; later spaces overwrite earlier expansion values. No remote folders means no pin scan. Each space stops scanning once every relevant ID has matched. 400 seeded baseline comparisons and current zero/one/two-folder early scans pass. Per-space Set construction still costs work when few/no matching local folders exist; count reductions are not physical RAM/CPU evidence.

reviewedInvariants.topic: Claude incremental malformed overlap and final validation
reviewedInvariants.assessment: The state machine preserves the first one-shot text-key match, including adjacent malformed overlapping prefixes. It suppresses incomplete escapes, raw trailing backslash-pair prefixes and invalid escape/control text consistently with partialText. Block resets match only an already emitted prefix, avoiding duplicate content. Successful results still require string text and an own action field, with result-string JSON fallback and inherited final-prefix behavior. Round listeners/timer are cleaned on supported terminal paths. Current tests and 28057 old/new comparisons show no introduced event/result difference. These checks do not certify all CLI lifecycle/cancellation cases or arbitrary malformed streams.

reviewedInvariants.topic: Organato bounds, BOMs and stalled cancellation
reviewedInvariants.assessment: The limit remains 2000000 decoded UTF-16 code units after pinned-runtime leading BOM handling, not a UTF-8 byte cap. 65536-byte subviews bound decode work within a single oversized delivered chunk. Up to two initial BOMs are removed across split bytes; third/fourth remain invalid JSON as before. Final decoder flush participates in the limit. Failure starts cancellation without awaiting its possibly stalled promise, suppresses cancellation rejection, preserves the original error and releases the reader lock. All exact-limit/UTF8/replacement/BOM/stalled/rejected cancellation checks pass with native Response and injected fetcher. No network/keychain/config operation occurred.

Actual Chrome partial-commit reachability remains unestablished. Current rejected-apply test models rejection before writes, not arbitrary crash atomicity. This review does not revive it as an introduced defect or claim it fixed; prior partial-write experiment was read, not rerun.

An uninterrupted paragraph, list or open fence still rebuilds the complete mutable tail, with an additional newline scan. Full final render and complete conversation text remain intentional. No transcript pruning proposed.

The decoder cannot bound an already delivered transport chunk or upstream queued allocations. String concatenation, flattening and parsed-object costs remain unmeasured. A never-settling underlying cancel may retain its own resources despite release of this reader lock.
Rejected translation WeakRef pruning remains rejected. No translation pruning, content dropping or recovery-durability shortcuts are recommended by this report.
